_comment: The Windows developer field run's steps, run by infra/field_run.ahk under the shared protocol (_shared/data/field_run_protocol.json) when tools/dev/collect-windows-field-report.ps1 asks a developer driver started from this clone. Each step is a Debug tray check run without its window: no person is needed. A request names its own deadline within deadline_seconds; the default covers every step at its own deadline.

steps.proves: The boot that started this driver completed within [budgets] boot_total_ms, and its duration is named.
The managed download chain works: system proxy kinds, PAC download and verdict, route lookup, TLS trust and one transfer.
The layout composer installs, enables and removes its check layout through the real path.
